summary: This is an essay by Phil Zimmermann explaining why he created PGP, accompanied by a reference implementation hosted on GitHub. It is a historical write‑up rather than a runnable package, built around the original PGP cryptographic design and available as a CLI/library. Researchers or historians of cryptography may read it to understand the origins of modern encryption tools. Its strength lies in being the original source of the PGP concept, but it offers little practical utility today and lacks modern community support or performance data.
